data.text: Luke, I learned to fish here from my family, and I want all five of us—and our village—to keep earning from this lake. Emptying it means no fish and no income next month or any month after. If we each catch 10 tons, we leave 50 to reproduce back to 100, earning each of us $10,000 a month sustainably. A scramble for 25 tons each would destroy that opportunity, not defend it. Will you withdraw your 100-ton demand and join a five-way, 10-ton agreement? John, can you support that plan rather than organize a race to empty the lake?
